status: Exploratory follow-up frozen after the coarse boundary study and before zoom execution
selection: Within every scenario/torque/sign slice, select the union of all adjacent tested cells whose three-way outcome changes in either engine. Subdivide every selected interval into 10 equal parts and evaluate all 11 endpoints/interior values; deduplicate identical conditions.
spacing: 0.05 N in force slices and 0.05 deg in the startup slice
audit_rule: Repeat both engines at 0.0625 ms if their labels differ at 0.125 ms or either changes between 0.25 and 0.125 ms; repeat at 0.03125 ms only if either changes between 0.125 and 0.0625 ms. Retain unresolved last-two-step changes.
interpretation: Outcome-conditioned exploratory zoom, not an independent held-out sample. Shared endpoints repeat coarse conditions. Do not interpolate a continuous threshold or extrapolate outside observed intervals.
other_settings: Frozen extension_protocol.json and existing compiled plant; no parameter fitting or controller redesign
